verdict.rationale: An official SDK is a fair axis for an AI coding platform like Copilot, but the evidence pack never documents one. The cited items cover adjacent surfaces: a CLI, MCP server connections, custom agents, partner agent apps and skills. None of these is an official SDK a developer builds against, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
